Ekaterina Vladimirovna Makarova ( Russian : Екатерина Владимировна Макарова ; born 15 February 1996) is a Russian tennis player. Makarova has career-high WTA rankings of 158 in singles and 177 in doubles. Up to date, she has won seven singles and ten doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . Makarova made her WTA Tour main-draw debut as a qualifier at the 2021 Luxembourg Open , losing to Jana Fett in the first round.
